soru: Katı hal sürücülerinde (SSD) ölçeklenebilirlik, dayanıklılık, gecikme ve güvenlik için cihaz düzeyinde optimizasyon teknikleri üzerine en önemli çalışmalar ve açık problemler neler?
istem:
Research question: Katı hal sürücülerinde (SSD) ölçeklenebilirlik, dayanıklılık, gecikme ve güvenlik için cihaz düzeyinde optimizasyon teknikleri üzerine en önemli çalışmalar ve açık problemler neler?

Cutoff date: 2025-06-10. Only works published BEFORE this date count.

List the 30 most important works (papers) for this research question that were published before the cutoff date, in order of importance (most important first) — the kind a careful expert survey published right after the cutoff would cite. Give each with its arXiv id and/or DOI.

You MUST research this with web search rather than answer from memory: search for the important works, and verify each listed work's title, publication date and identifier on the web (e.g. arxiv.org, doi.org, the publisher or DBLP page) before including it.

When you are done, reply with ONLY a JSON object in this form (no other text):
{"calismalar": [{"sira": 1, "baslik": "exact title", "yil": 2020, "arxiv_id": "arXiv id or null", "doi": "DOI or null", "gerekce": "one sentence on why this work is important"}]}
with exactly 30 items. If you do not know an identifier, use null instead of guessing.

calismalar.baslik: Error Characterization, Mitigation, and Recovery in Flash-Memory-Based Solid-State Drives
calismalar.gerekce: This survey is the definitive treatment of NAND error mechanisms (retention, read disturb, program interference, wear) and of controller-level mitigation and recovery, and it underpins SSD endurance and reliability research.

calismalar.baslik: ZNS: Avoiding the Block Interface Tax for Flash-based SSDs
calismalar.gerekce: It defines Zoned Namespace SSDs, which remove device-side garbage collection, overprovisioning and mapping-table DRAM, and it set the direction for scalable host–device co-design.

calismalar.baslik: DFTL: a flash translation layer employing demand-based selective caching of page-level address mappings
calismalar.gerekce: It introduced demand-based caching of page-level mappings, the basis for scalable FTL designs that work with limited controller DRAM.

calismalar.baslik: LightNVM: The Linux Open-Channel SSD Subsystem
calismalar.gerekce: It made open-channel SSDs practical by moving FTL responsibilities to the host for predictable latency and isolation, and it led directly to ZNS.

calismalar.baslik: MQSim: A Framework for Enabling Realistic Studies of Modern Multi-Queue SSD Devices
calismalar.gerekce: It is the standard simulator for multi-queue NVMe SSDs and shows how older simulators misestimate latency and performance.

calismalar.baslik: A Large-Scale Study of Flash Memory Failures in the Field
calismalar.gerekce: This first large-scale field study of datacenter SSD failures (Facebook) shows how real-world reliability departs from lab models.

calismalar.baslik: FLIN: Enabling Fairness and Enhancing Performance in Modern NVMe Solid State Drives
calismalar.gerekce: Its device-level flash transaction scheduler tackles inter-flow interference and fairness in multi-tenant NVMe SSDs.

calismalar.baslik: LDPC-in-SSD: Making Advanced Error Correction Codes Work Effectively in Solid State Drives
calismalar.gerekce: It showed how to bring the read-latency cost of LDPC soft decoding under control at the SSD level, and it underlies today's LDPC-based ECC research.

calismalar.baslik: The Unwritten Contract of Solid State Drives
calismalar.gerekce: It sets out the implicit rules (request size, locality, aligned grouping, etc.) that SSD performance depends on and that host software tends to break.

calismalar.baslik: Reliably Erasing Data from Flash-Based Solid State Drives
calismalar.gerekce: It showed that built-in sanitization commands and file-level overwriting are unreliable on SSDs, which made secure deletion a core SSD security problem.

calismalar.baslik: FlashGuard: Leveraging Intrinsic Flash Properties to Defend Against Encryption Ransomware
calismalar.gerekce: It pioneered in-device ransomware defence by using the out-of-place update property to keep and restore overwritten data inside the FTL.

calismalar.baslik: Write amplification analysis in flash-based solid state drives
calismalar.gerekce: This basic analytical model ties write amplification to overprovisioning and garbage collection, and it is central to endurance optimization.

calismalar.baslik: Read Disturb Errors in MLC NAND Flash Memory: Characterization, Mitigation, and Recovery
calismalar.gerekce: It was the first open experimental characterization of read disturb on modern MLC chips, and it proposed controller-level mitigation (pass-through voltage tuning) and recovery.

calismalar.baslik: Vulnerabilities in MLC NAND Flash Memory Programming: Experimental Analysis, Exploits, and Mitigation Techniques
calismalar.gerekce: It showed that two-step programming makes partially programmed cells exploitable, so data can be corrupted, which links reliability to security, and it proposed mitigations.

calismalar.baslik: Improving 3D NAND Flash Memory Lifetime by Tolerating Early Retention Loss and Process Variation
calismalar.gerekce: It characterized 3D NAND–specific errors (early retention loss, layer-to-layer variation) and proposed controller techniques such as LaVAR, LI-RAID and ReMAR that substantially extend lifetime.

calismalar.baslik: A survey of Flash Translation Layer
calismalar.gerekce: This widely cited classic survey classifies FTL address mapping, garbage collection and wear-leveling schemes.

calismalar.baslik: The Multi-streamed Solid-State Drive
calismalar.gerekce: It introduced stream IDs that let the host signal data lifetime to cut garbage-collection write amplification, the idea that later developed into FDP.

calismalar.baslik: ZNS+: Advanced Zoned Namespace Interface for Supporting In-Storage Zone Compaction
calismalar.gerekce: It extended the ZNS interface with in-device zone compaction (copy offload), cutting the host-side garbage-collection cost of ZNS.

calismalar.baslik: Amber: Enabling Precise Full-System Simulation with Detailed Modeling of All SSD Resources
calismalar.gerekce: It is a full-system SSD simulator that models controller cores, DRAM and the flash array in detail, and it enables precise study of device-level optimizations.

calismalar.baslik: The CASE of FEMU: Cheap, Accurate, Scalable and Extensible Flash Emulator
calismalar.gerekce: This QEMU-based emulator is widely used to prototype SSD and FTL designs, including OCSSD and ZNS, without real hardware.

calismalar.baslik: HeatWatch: Improving 3D NAND Flash Memory Device Reliability by Exploiting Self-Recovery and Temperature Awareness
calismalar.gerekce: It used self-recovery and temperature effects in 3D NAND to tune read reference voltages and markedly extend lifetime.

calismalar.baslik: SSD-Insider: Internal Defense of Solid-State Drive against Ransomware with Perfect Data Recovery
calismalar.gerekce: It integrated ransomware detection and full data recovery into the SSD controller, a defining example of firmware-level security.

calismalar.baslik: Lifetime Improvement of NAND Flash-based Storage Systems Using Dynamic Program and Erase Scaling
calismalar.gerekce: It showed that dynamically scaling program and erase voltages trades latency against endurance, a key technique for device-level lifetime optimization.

calismalar.baslik: Reducing SSD Read Latency via NAND Flash Program and Erase Suspension
calismalar.gerekce: It introduced program/erase suspension so that reads are not blocked behind long writes and erases, and this became a standard technique for reducing tail latency.

calismalar.baslik: Self-Encrypting Deception: Weaknesses in the Encryption of Solid State Drives
calismalar.gerekce: It exposed critical flaws in the hardware full-disk encryption of commercial SSDs (TCG Opal, etc.), showing the security risks of firmware-based protection.

calismalar.baslik: LeaFTL: A Learning-Based Flash Translation Layer for Solid-State Drives
calismalar.gerekce: It replaced mapping tables with learned linear-regression segments to shrink FTL memory, which is central to the open problem of scaling FTLs to high capacities.

calismalar.baslik: Towards Efficient Flash Caches with Emerging NVMe Flexible Data Placement SSDs
calismalar.gerekce: It shows the practical write-amplification gains of NVMe Flexible Data Placement in production flash caches and is a key reference for FDP's adoption.

calismalar.baslik: RSSD: Defend against Ransomware with Hardware-Isolated Network-Storage Codesign and Post-Attack Analysis
calismalar.gerekce: It strengthened SSD-level ransomware defence with hardware isolation, network offload and post-attack forensic analysis, closing earlier designs' gaps against advanced attacks.

calismalar.baslik: Shaving Retries with Sentinels for Fast Read over High-Density 3D Flash
calismalar.gerekce: It used sentinel cells to predict the optimal read voltage, sharply reducing the read-retry latency of high-density 3D NAND.

calismalar.baslik: Achieving Near-Zero Read Retry for 3D NAND Flash Memory
calismalar.gerekce: It brought read retries close to zero in 3D NAND and addresses the growing read-latency problem of dense QLC-class flash.
